name: Lauda-Königshofen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Lauda-Königshofen (a crown and a diagonal banner-lance on blue).
history: Arms and the flag without arms were granted by the Landratsamt Main-Tauber-Kreis on 25 August 1977.

features.role: Lauda-Königshofen arms — crown and lance on blue
